label: Stability AI
reason: Remaining gap: storing binary results and returning a link. Re-read 2026-09-25 (OpenAPI https://api.stability.ai/v2alpha/openapi): every Stable Image generate/edit call (e.g. POST /v2beta/stable-image/generate/core|ultra|sd3) and async result (GET /v2beta/results/{id}) answers only with the image itself — image/png|jpeg|webp bytes (ImageBinaryResponse) or the whole image base64-encoded in JSON (ImageJSONResponse: {image, finish_reason, seed}); no URL is ever returned. The runtime now sends multipart uploads, cookies, JWT assertions and parses CSV/XML, but it cannot persist a returned file and hand back a URL, and megabytes of base64 in a tool result are not usable, so generate_image cannot produce output_urls.
